prompt.text: A friend says, "Mean, median and range all tell you the same thing about a data set." Do you agree? Use the homework data from Part 6 in your answer.

criteria.label: Correct meaning of each measure
criteria.description: Mean = average, median = middle, range = spread

criteria.label: Uses the homework data
criteria.description: Quotes the median of 20 or range of 18

answer.text: Disagree. The mean and median measure the centre; the range measures spread.
For the homework data the median is 20 minutes but the range is 18 minutes, which tells you something different.

solution.text: Centre and spread are different ideas: two data sets can share a median but have very different ranges.
